expectation: Nuclear stain. Expected in endothelial nuclei lining vessels, and in naive or quiescent T cells, which should cluster in lymphoid aggregates and T zones. It should mark a subset of CD3E+ cells and scattered vessel linings, with no glow in epithelium or muscle.
notes: KLF2 shows as haze that follows tissue layers and spreads off the tissue in stripes and glow. No nuclei light up along vessels. Cell-sized spots in the lymphoid field are dense everywhere and do not sit on the CD3E cells.
observed: A: yellow haze across the whole slide, off-tissue too, with stripes, gradients and debris dots. B, C, D: diffuse stromal haze, no distinct stained nuclei. E1: blob speckle evenly dense. E3: green mostly beside magenta, little white, as dense where CD3E is low.
why: The signal follows tissue texture and background glow, not a specific nuclear population; in row E it is not enriched on CD3E cells.
